svg.text: χ² with k degrees of freedom = the sum of k squared standard normal values, Z₁² + Z₂² + … + Zₖ²
the dot marks the mean, μ = k
more df → the curve moves right
the curve used in the absences example
mean μ = k · variance σ² = 2k · SD σ = √(2k)
only x > 0, because a sum of squares is never negative
df = 4 tail: P(χ² > x) = e−x/2 (1 + x/2)
